description: activity-api execution traces do not record the dispatch's originally-requested target_template_id. Detector probed target_template_id, dispatch_target_template_id, requested_template_id across 100 recent rows and found none. Without this field, dispatch-target-drift (caller says X, Thompson/recommend selects Y) is structurally invisible to the substrate. Fix path: extend AET schema + trace-write path in repos/activity-api so goal-host can persist the requested target alongside the selected variant_id.
